top_signals.title: Coinsbuy offers $100K reward after Sunday security breach
top_signals.summary: Coinsbuy said it covered all affected client funds after unauthorized withdrawals, while an onchain investigator estimated more than $7.9 million was stolen.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chile Gives Struggling Copper Giant Codelco a $2.4 Billion Boost
top_signals.summary: Chile’s government will allow state-owned Codelco to retain all of its 2025 profit, leaving about $2.42 billion in the copper giant as it looks to revive production and ease a record debt burden.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Archer shares surge after Boeing stake, electric aircraft subsidiary deal
top_signals.summary: Boeing is selling three of its subsidiaries to Archer Aviation in exchange for a stake in the eVTOL startup.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Intel plans $15 billion stock offering as AI demand accelerates
top_signals.summary: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
